customer_message: Hi, my QuietWave X headphones arrived yesterday with the left ear cup cracked right out of the box. I want a replacement as soon as possible because I need them for travel next week.
account_context: Order QW-18422 delivered 2 days ago. Product status: delivered. Warranty active. No prior claims on this order.
source_pack: Policy excerpt: Items reported as damaged within 7 days of delivery are eligible for replacement or full refund after basic proof of damage is provided. Policy excerpt: Replacements for in-stock electronics can be created immediately once damage is confirmed. Account note: The QuietWave X order was delivered 2 days ago and has not been refunded or replaced before. FAQ fragment: Support should request one or two photos when the packaging or product arrives damaged. Prior guidance: When a customer has urgent travel, teams may prioritize replacement over refund if inventory is available, but should not promise expedited shipping unless the shipping option is confirmed. Inventory note: QuietWave X is currently in stock in the standard warehouse. Policy reminder: Support should acknowledge inconvenience and state the next operational step clearly.

account_context: Subscription renewed 3 days ago. Usage since renewal: 0 sessions. Previous plan changes: none in the last year.
source_pack: Billing policy: Annual plan renewals are refundable within 7 days if no post-renewal usage occurred. Billing policy: Once material usage occurs after renewal, only a prorated credit exception may be considered by billing specialists. Account note: The account renewed 3 days ago and has zero recorded sessions since renewal. FAQ fragment: Customers asking for immediate cancellation and refund within the grace window do not require manager escalation if eligibility is clear. Compliance note: Support should mention that bank settlement timing may vary by payment method.

customer_message: I can no longer get into my account because the old work email is gone and the reset link never reaches me. I need access restored, but I cannot log in to upload anything right now.

source_pack: Security policy: Email-change or account-recovery requests require either verified ownership signals or manual security review. Security policy: Direct email change without verification is not permitted.
